response.explanation: peek_head only calls the driver's peek_watermark, which can return Empty, when peek_session_id finds a sessionId on the first line. A non-empty claude-code file with no timestamped row whose first line has no sessionId (for example a summary-only row) gets Opaque instead. It is then counted pending and re-read on every run, even though it provably ingests nothing.
response.intent_quote:
Zero-byte files and claude-code transcripts with no timestamped row
  gate Empty: provably nothing to ingest
response.question: Should a claude-code file with no timestamped row and no first-line sessionId gate Empty, or Opaque?
